title: Chapter 1103
paragraphs: Chapter 1103
Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (7)
“Is that so? It's quite a pity that you are not as you were in the old days.”
It was not sarcasm. Chiron was lamenting the fact that Vahn's prime had passed.
Because the future of the war was still bleak.

Of course, Chiron was overwhelming the enemies on his own right now, but the battle would not end like this. Even if he were to annihilate the ten new Genesis Knights and the entire fleet, the enemies would just send out a new force of the same size.
The Vamel Alliance had to hold out for five days.

However, not even a single day had passed yet. And even if they did hold out for five days in the end, there was no guarantee that Solderet's arrangement would surely turn this entire situation around.
“Well, if not, then not; if we don't have it, then we don't. Isn't it the way of people like us to fight and win somehow.”
“Many will die.”
“They will.”
“...However, you and I must survive to the end and wait for the youngest.”
“Yes... of course, we must.”

In the storm of Chiron's sword-aura that was raging across the entire battlefield like a blizzard, the white fleets were continuously being decomposed. Now, all the allies had escaped the influence of Realm of Emptiness and were seen finding and attacking the enemies with their vision restored.
Jin, along with his companions, had moved to the right flank of the battlefield and was facing a Genesis Knight of the Demon Army who had barely managed to survive.

He had already lost an arm to Chiron's sword and had also sustained a fatal wound to his abdomen. His face was covered by a hood, so it was impossible to tell who he was. Jin and his companions silently plunged their swords and claws into his body.
“Keoheok...!”
They did not wonder who he was or from which dimension he came, nor did they feel any strange emotion at the fact that the realm of a Genesis Knight could fall so meaninglessly.
This was a battlefield where Genesis Knights died like common soldiers.
That meant that the coalition's Genesis Knights could also become like that at any time. There was no need to even mention the superhumans and other powerful individuals.
“Murakan, you fall back again and focus on protecting Vale and our allies. Our forces need to push in and form a line.”
[Got it.]
The ultimate technique, Realm of Emptiness; Chiron's sword could not be maintained forever.

A day at most, and even that was a realm that was only possible if Chiron were to overwork himself to the point of being unable to use his body for a month afterward. To be able to fight properly even after finishing the ultimate technique, about three hours was the limit.
Jin, along with Luna, was tracking the Genesis Knights who had fallen into it, and whenever he had a chance, he looked up at the dimensional gates.

The Demon Army was still sending out troops. Due to the pressure of Realm of Emptiness, the speed at which the white fleets were emerging from the dimensional gates was slower than before, but the scale was similar.
'The enemy commander is not revising his strategy at all. Does he still have enough troops to use as arrow fodder?'
A fleet numbering in the tens of thousands, Genesis Knights numbering at least in the dozens.
That alone was a force that the coalition had never even imagined, but they could by no means be called the 'core' of the Demon Army.
A completed Origin Stone, and the Kelliark Zipfel of the 33rd dimension.

For the coalition, who had already experienced Kelliark, they were thinking that even those outrageous enemies were nothing compared to him. If the Origin Stone and Kelliark were to appear on the battlefield in this situation, it would be no different from an impossible situation to respond to.
'...No, from now on, speculation and hypotheses are meaningless. If I fight while assuming the worst-case scenario, there will be no end. I will hold out for five days, somehow.'
Cutting, stabbing, breaking.
While Chiron was tying down all the enemy forces, Jin and the coalition members did not rest for a moment, scouring the battlefield and ending the enemies' lives.
Nevertheless, the Demon Army stubbornly maintained an average of about six hundred white fleets on the battlefield and consistently sent out seven or more Genesis Knights.
Two hours passed like that. Even then, the composition was a one-sided trampling of the Demon Army by the coalition, centered on Chiron.
However, among the Genesis Knights of the Demon Army, a person who properly counterattacked Jin and Luna from within Realm of Emptiness appeared for the first time.
Lady Elona!?
As he struck away a spear of magic that had flown at his head, Jin almost shouted as such. The one who had attacked Jin and Luna was an Elona Zipfel from another dimension.
Furthermore, it was not just one person. Another spear from another Elona was already flying in from behind the two of them.
They were different from the other Genesis Knights of the Demon Army that the coalition had killed until now.

It didn't mean they were of a high caliber like Chiron or Vahn, or that they had a special will like Jin. They just felt like war machines that possessed a combat ability beyond that of a Genesis Knight.

The two Elonas both looked exactly the same. On their heads, they were wearing a Holy Crown of a slightly different form than the one Jin had seen, and on their left cheeks, the numbers 24 and 89 were standing out like a brand.
There was no life in their eyes, but even when they were still, an enormous amount of magic and sun energy was being emitted from their entire bodies.
'...Did they turn Lady Elona and Malugia from other dimensions into weapons!'
He was correct.
When Kelliark of the Demon Army had faced the Malugias of all dimensions until now, he had not just taken their lives.

Some of them, he had personally turned into weapons using his completed Origin Stone and his own authority. They were called the Holy Army within the Demon Army, and the numbers branded on their cheeks signified the number of the dimension they were from.

In other words, they were Malugias who had become living weapons in the form of Elona. Since they were not fundamentally mortals, they were madly regenerating even while their entire bodies were being torn apart by Realm of Emptiness and had reached Jin and Luna.
Even now, as they stood before the two, their bodies were repeatedly decomposing and regenerating in real time due to Realm of Emptiness

This was not the time to be shocked. Jin and Luna simultaneously extended their swords towards number 24. Under the combined attack of Realm of Emptiness and the two of them, number 24's head was instantly sent falling to the floor, but as expected, she showed a sight of regenerating as if nothing had happened.

Furthermore, even while regenerating, she showed the monstrous strength of exploding sun energy in all directions, an energy that was enough to cover the entire battlefield if it were not suppressed by Realm of Emptiness.
'The depth of their pure martial prowess is nothing compared to a Genesis Knight. But their attack power and regenerative ability... is a disaster.'
So to speak, each member of the Holy Army was like an ego of the Sun God. In reality, they could be said to be Malugias in the form of Elona.
In other words, attempting to seal them was a more effective countermeasure than trying to annihilate them. Jin immediately saw through their essence and gave an order to the fleet.
“Prepare the restraints! Until the restraint is complete, the superhumans of the flagship Sarah will hold onto the Elona Zipples and buy as much time as possible!”
For Jin, it was an order that required a decision.

Those who were not Genesis Knights could suddenly be killed in action at any time while facing the Elonas of the Holy Army. But if the Genesis Knights were tied down by the Holy Army for that reason, in the end, a greater loss would follow. He also didn't know how many more Elonas would be added in the future.

His companions and coalition members could die because of his order. The fact suddenly stabbed at his insides like a sword, but this was a battlefield, and all those who stood against the enemy were warriors.
Finally, Jin had made his resolve. Just as his companions had already done long ago.
Jin and Luna did not face the Elonas at all. The two of them bypassed them and tracked the other Genesis Knights who had not been able to escape the Realm of Emptiness.
Of the ten Genesis Knights, only three were now breathing. They had to finish all of them off before the next Genesis Knights appeared.

'The Demon Army is highly likely to try and maintain the number of Genesis Knights at 10 or more from now on. When Father's ultimate technique ends, the number of surviving Genesis Knights will increase in earnest. We have to match their numbers with ours as much as possible!'
It was impossible to match the number of superhumans. Instead, the superhumans' battle could be led based on the advantage in fleet strength.
The Holy Army could not pursue the two. The coalition's superhumans, including Hedo and Vanessa, were already blocking them.
“They say that my stray cat and I also have the power of the Sun God dwelling strongly within us, but thankfully we met a good lord and did not end up like them.”
“Even here, you're talking about cats, Vanessa.”
“You used to play along well, meowing and all, but your reaction now is disappointing. I'd like to ask you one favor, Hedo.”
“What is it?”
“Awaken. Because it seems that the fewer things there are for the Young Patriarch to be sad about, the better, if you become stronger.”
A Genesis Knight, Vanessa believed that Hedo, unlike her, could ascend to that realm. All the former Black Knights thought so.
“I was planning to do so for the sake of Lady Sandra as well.”

“To hear you answer as if you can become a Genesis Knight at any time is quite pathetic. Who do you think you are, just a cat? And I don't think your lady would shed a single tear even if you were to die at any time.”
“If such a thing were to happen, I sincerely hope that my lady would not be so sad. Because she will have to live well even without me.”
“It makes me feel sorry for responding so seriously to a joke. Don't worry, I will protect our cat.”
The Elonas just looked at Hedo, Vanessa, and the superhumans and said this.
[...Beginning elimination of key enemy personnel. Lord Rondo, I will share my vision from now on.]
'That's... not a Genesis Knight? And what's more, Hedo?'

The members of the Demon Army were once again engulfed in shock as they checked the vision shared by the Elonas number 24 and 89. They had expected that two members of the Holy Army would be able to inflict meaningful damage on the enemies even within Chiron's ultimate technique, but the coalition's superhumans who appeared on the screen were fighting as if they were Genesis Knights.
It wouldn't be strange if they were to suddenly become real Genesis Knights at any time.

Naturally, Hedo was a person who existed in every dimension. Hedo was also included among Rondo's subordinates right now. And as far as Rondo knew, Hedo had never reached the state of a Genesis Knight in any world.

Most had met their deaths after continuing meaningless betrayals and resistances, or had been modified into weapons by the Origin Stone, like the Holy Army. From the perspective of the Demon Army, Hedo was a convenient person to weaponize thanks to the sun energy he was born with.
'...I must assume that that man will ascend to a Genesis Knight. Damn it, all the information and data we have accumulated from all dimensions until now is as good as useless here.'
Since the battle began until now, the Demon Army had been receiving massive damage, but the Vamel Alliance was fine.
That fact continuously grated on Rondo's nerves. Rondo suppressed his anger and continued to stare at Elona's screen.
'Still, the horrific sword that Chiron has unfolded is slowly subsiding... Now, I will show them why we rule all dimensions.'
